hadiths.english_translation: Ma'mar said, and Al-Hassan said: 'The tar (used) for camels.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ حَمَّادٍ , عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ سورة الحجر آية 2 , قَالَ : " إِنَّ أَهْلَ النَّارِ ، يَقُولُونَ : كُنَّا أَهْلَ شِرْكٍ وَكُفْرٍ فَمَا شَأْنُ هَؤُلاءِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ ، مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ عِبَادَتُهُمْ إِيَّاهُ ؟ " ، قَالَ : " فَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ " , قَالَ : " فَعِنْدَ ذَلِكَ يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, regarding Allah's saying: 'Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims' (Surah al-Hijr verse 2), he said: 'The people of the Fire will say: We were people of shirk and disbelief, so what is the matter with these monotheists - what did their worship benefit them?' He said: 'Then whoever was among the Muslims will exit the Fire.' He said: 'At that point, those who disbelieved will wish they had been Muslims.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ , عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ , وَعَنْ خُصَيْفٍ , عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ , قَالا : يَقُولُ أَهْلُ النَّارِ لِلْمُوَحِّدِينَ : " مَا أَغْنَى عَنْكُمْ إِيمَانُكُمْ ؟ " , قَالَ : " فَإِذَا قَالُوا ، قَالَ اللَّهُ : أَخْرِجُوا مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ ، فَعِنْدَ ذَلِكَ " رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ سورة الحجر آية 2 , قَالَ : " يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Al-Thawri, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, and from Khusayf, from Mujahid, they both said: The people of the Fire will say to the monotheists: 'What did your faith benefit you?' He said: 'When they say that, Allah will say: Bring out whoever had in his heart the weight of an atom, and at that point' - 'Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims' (Surah al-Hijr verse 2), he said: 'On the Day of Resurrection.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , وَثَابِتٍ ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ سورة الحجر آية 9 , قَالَ : " حَفِظَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَزِيدَ فِيهِ الشَّيْطَانُ بَاطِلا , أَوْ يُبْطِلَ مِنْهُ حَقًّا "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah and Thabit, regarding Allah's saying: 'Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder (Quran), and indeed, We will be its guardian' (Surah al-Hijr verse 9), he said: 'Allah protected it so that Satan cannot add falsehood to it nor invalidate any truth from it.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ { 12 } لا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ سورة الحجر آية 12-13 , قَالَ : " إِذَا كَذَّبُوا سَلَكَ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ أنْ لا يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding Allah's saying: 'Thus do We insert it into the hearts of the criminals. They will not believe in it' (Surah al-Hijr verses 12-13), he said: 'When they denied, Allah placed in their hearts that they would not believe in it.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوا فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ سورة الحجر آية 14 , قَالَ : " لَوْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بَابًا ، فَظَلَّتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ تَعْرُجُ فِيهِ " , يَقُولُ : " يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ذَاهِبِينَ , وَجَائِينَ ، فَقَالُوا : " سُحِرَتْ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, from Ibn Abbas, regarding Allah's saying: 'And if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend' (Surah al-Hijr verse 14), he said: 'If Allah opened for them a gate from the heaven, and the angels kept ascending through it,' meaning: 'They would go back and forth through it, coming and going, they would say: We have been bewitched.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , عَنْ حَيَّانَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ , عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ , قَالَ : " مَا رَاحَتْ جَنُوبٌ قَطُّ ، إِلا سَالَ فِي وَادٍ مَاءٌ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ , أَوْ لَمْ تَرَوْهُ "

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ , عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ , قَالَ : " الْجَنُوبُ سَيِّدَةُ الرِّيَاحِ , وَاسْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ الأَزِيبُ , وَمِنْ دُونِهَا سَبْعَةٌ أُنْزِلَتْ , وَإِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ مِنْ خَلْفِهَا ، لَوْ فُتِحَ مِنْهَا بَابٌ وَاحِدٌ لأَذْرَتْ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ , وَالأَرْضِ , وَهِيَ رِيحُ الْجَنَّةِ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from 'Amr ibn Dinar, from Ibn Abbas, he said: 'The south wind is the master of winds, and its name with Allah is al-Azib (the strong one). Below it, seven (levels) were sent down, and what reaches you is only from behind it. If one gate of it were opened, it would scatter everything between heaven and earth, and it is the wind of Paradise.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ , عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ , قَالَتْ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، إِذَا رَأَى مَخِيلَةً تَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُهُ وَدَخَلَ ، وَخَرَجَ , وَأَقْبَلَ ، وَأَدْبَرَ ، فَإِذَا أَمْطَرَتْ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ , فَقَالَ : " مَا أَمِنْتُ أَنْ تَكُونَ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ : فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ سورة الأحقاف آية 24 إِلَى قَوْلِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ سورة الأحقاف آية 24
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Aisha, she said: When the Prophet ﷺ saw clouds gathering, his face would change and he would enter, exit, come forward and go back. When it rained, his anxiety would be relieved. I mentioned this to him, and he said: 'I cannot be certain it might not be as Allah said: When they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys... a wind wherein is a painful punishment' (Surah al-Ahqaf verse 24).

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ , عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ , قَالَ : " كَانَ يُقَالُ إِذَا هَاجَتْ رِيحٌ ، أَوْ ظُلْمَةٌ " , قَالَ : " اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا رِيَاحًا لَوَاقِحَ ، لا رِيحًا عَقِيمًا "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, he said: 'It used to be said when wind stirred up or darkness (came): O Allah, make it fertilizing winds, not a barren wind.'

narrators.name: Ma'mar
narrators.full_name: Ma'mar ibn Abi 'Amr Rashid al-Azdi al-Basri

narrators.name: Mansur
narrators.full_name: Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir al-Sulami al-Kufi

narrators.name: Ibrahim
narrators.full_name: Ibrahim ibn Yazid ibn Qays al-Nakha'i al-Kufi

chainIssues: Ibrahim says 'it used to be said' without clear attribution

potential_issues.issue: Ibrahim uses 'kana yuqal' (it used to be said) without identifying who said it
potential_issues.impact: This is a saying transmitted by Ibrahim without clear attribution to a specific person

potential_issues.issue: Maqtu' or possibly mursal - unclear source
potential_issues.impact: Cannot determine if this goes back to Prophet ﷺ or is just a saying from early Muslims
